snippet.title: Cosmic Dominion | Official Trailer | 2D space combat meets 4X strategy
snippet.description:
Fly the cockpit yourself in fast 2D dogfights, then step back and run a full galactic war. Wishlist on https://store.steampowered.com/app/5292570/Cosmic_Dominion/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=channel_cd&utm_content=trailer

Cosmic Dominion is a 2D space-combat strategy game from a solo developer. Capture planets, automate their economies, and outplay AI commanders who mine, trade, colonize and pick their own wars.

• Six weapon slots, each on its own upgrade track: cannons, beam lasers, homing missiles, blast ordnance, disruptors and support rounds
• Siege and boarding: break a world's shields, breach its hull, land a party and watch it change hands
• Living planets that mine their own ore, build their own defenses and pay you a cut of everything they earn
• Rival AI commanders running the same economy you are, not spawning waves at you
• An Insectoid swarm that is hostile to everyone once a portal opens
• Custom galaxies: map size, planet count, teams, difficulty, wraparound edges and a seed you can share

Free demo on Steam, itch.io and in the browser on Unity Play within two weeks of this page going live. Steam Next Fest to follow.

Discord: https://discord.gg/GXBRDn3NZx
Website: https://cosmicdominion.com
X: https://x.com/cosmic_dominion
Instagram: https://instagram.com/cosmicdominiongame
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@cosmicdominiongame

Music: "Epic Trailer Juggernaut" by Luca Francini, licensed via Envato Elements.
